rows.title: Large source with one relevant code window
rows.task: Retrieve the relevant source window instead of the entire source file.

rows.title: Huge grep with a narrow needle
rows.task: Find the matching diagnostic line without returning the complete grep result.

rows.title: Huge JSON records with one relevant object
rows.task: Locate the matching JSON record and report its identifier.

rows.title: Large build log with sparse errors
rows.task: Identify the build error while keeping routine log lines out of Main.

rows.title: Hierarchical summary of a large source file
rows.task: Summarize the source structure under a bounded child-model input budget.

rows.title: Nested agent payload handoff
rows.task: Return a concise child-agent finding while keeping the inspected payload addressable.

rows.title: Parallel provider payloads
rows.task: Combine four independent provider results while returning only bounded evidence.

rows.title: Repeated reads of one offloaded payload
rows.task: Inspect three separate sections without copying the complete payload three times.
